ROCKSTAROS / RELEASE STATUS

One system
foundation.

RockstarOS is being built to connect approved avokado hardware, local services, and experiences with less setup between them.

PUBLIC INSTALLER NOT YET AVAILABLE

No device image, physical installation, payment, or reservation is available from this page.

WHAT IT IS FOR

Keep the experience together.

The goal is one trusted foundation for approved hardware, local services, games, storage, and connected experiences.

WHAT IT CONNECTS

Input in.
Approved action out.

RockstarOS keeps the path understandable: receive an input, check what is allowed, then send it to the experience.

CARE + MOTIONMovement record → review tool

Pass a session to an approved research or training workflow.

RESEARCH + DEVELOPMENTSensor input → developer app

Connect physical movement to a prototype without rebuilding the whole system.

EVERYDAY SPACEGesture → room action

Route a recognized trigger to an approved light, sound, or service.

GAMEPlayer movement → game session

Keep Mini input, Pro compute, audio, and play state together.
